```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: false

import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from ipykernel.connect import get_connection_file

Path(".qcell-kernel.json").write_text(json.dumps({
    "connection_file": get_connection_file(),
    "pid": os.getpid(),
    "python": sys.executable,
}))
```
